question:
Ask the same question three times and the answers don’t always agree. Spot the odd one out, then write a prompt that gives the AI less room to wander.

Steps:
1. Use the arrow tool to point at the answer that disagrees with the others.
2. Place a shape around the two answers that agree.
3. Use the text tool to write a better prompt with at least 2 details of context.
4. Record your voice explaining why two matching answers still don’t prove they are right.

rubric.description: No arrow, shape, or text is placed on the board, or the voice recording is missing or blank.
Student places an arrow and a shape, but types no new prompt.
Arrow points to Ask #3 AND a shape is on Ask #1 and Ask #2 AND the typed prompt adds at least 2 details of context (such as age group, a source, or the format of the answer).
Meets all of the above AND the voice recording says that two matching answers do not prove they are correct AND names one way a human could check.
